family.description: This family is represented by Autographa californica nuclear polyhedrosis virus (AcMNPV), Orf101 (also known as Protein C42) [[cite:PUB00097485]]. It plays a role in host nuclear actin polymerization by recruiting p78/73 protein that is capable of activating an actin-related protein 2/3 complex to initiate nuclear actin polymerization [[cite:PUB00097485]].
family.name: Autographa californica nuclear polyhedrosis virus (AcMNPV), Orf101
